_comment: Target WhatsApp groups for the daily CV-business ad. Use group JIDs (ending in @g.us); the bot must be a MEMBER of each. Invite links are NOT reliably resolvable on this gateway (WhatsApp channels resolve is unsupported and the directory is config-backed), so always list JIDs here. Edit this list to add/remove groups; no code change needed. Newly-joined groups for reference: Buying and Selling (120363292471414376@g.us), Zim Mining Company (120363411788614990@g.us).
_weekly_comment: Groups posted to only on specific weekdays instead of daily (the cron still runs every day; these are skipped on other days). Weekdays may be names (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun) or ints (Mon=0 .. Sun=6). Vacancy Lamp (120363407177302513@g.us) advertises CV making twice a week, on Monday and Thursday.
